caseName: Terminal Freight Handling Co. v. Solien
caseNameFull: Terminal Freight Handling Co. v. Solien, Regional Director, National Labor Relations Board Sears, Roebuck & Co. v. Solien, Regional Director, National Labor Relations Board and Terminal Freight Cooperative Assn. v. Solien, Regional Director, National Labor Relations Board

opinions.text: C. A. 8th Cir. Motions of Sears, Roebuck & Co. for leave to intervene in Nos. 71-609 and 71-925 denied. Certiorari denied. Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions and petitions. Reported below: No. 71-609, 444 F. 2d 699; No. 71-924, 450 F. 2d 353.
